name: Ben
title: Ben — Tools & Projects
tagline: Small tools, built to scratch my own itch.
description: Tools and projects by Ben (@diceben). Small, self-contained things — published in case they are useful to someone else.
about: I build small tools — mostly command line things, scripts and helpers that solve one problem properly instead of many problems halfway.
Almost everything here started as something I needed myself. If a tool survived past the weekend I built it in, it ends up on this page.
Everything is open source. Take it, fork it, break it.
